description: This file implements a command-line interface (CLI) for a universal project initializer tool. It processes CLI arguments for creating new projects of various types, retrieves template information, and optionally outputs commands or initializes projects. The code utilizes modules like argparse for argument parsing, json for data serialization, and custom modules for project configuration and template handling.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of key=value pairs into a dictionary with appropriately typed values.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig instance from CLI arguments.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a minimal ProjectConfig instance for retrieving template info based on project type and optional parameters.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path based on a given base path.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a TemplateInitInfo instance into a dictionary with absolute paths and configuration details for JSON serialization.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Outputs a structured JSON response indicating success or failure, including optional template info.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Outputs the run command for a specified project type in JSON format.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Handles fetching and displaying the run command for a specific project type based on CLI input.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: The main CLI entry point that parses arguments, handles project initialization or retrieving run commands, and manages program flow.

ctags.signature: (success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
